feasibility.buildNote: cleanBuildSec and incrementalRebuildSec measure the single-tree freeze build; the evaluator builds candidate and reference trees in each eval
feasibility.evalSecNote: mean containerized eval wall across the two admission ordering passes (3060.0s and 3060.9s wall, 14 evals each) under ambient VM contention; includes the candidate plus in-eval reference harness builds and nine timed bench repetitions per phase per workload

measurement.benchSampling: per workload: pristine in-eval reference and candidate bench legs interleaved seconds apart, in per-repetition alternating leg order so time-monotone host drift within a repetition (container spin-up decay, thermal ramp) biases neither leg's per-phase minimum, on the same trusted per-iteration parse-go token stream (one unpredictable 64-bit token per timed iteration, drawn by the trusted parent from the OS CSPRNG via secrets.token_bytes at repetition start, stored once, and replayed identically to both legs; never derived from enumerable fields such as workload id, repetition, phase, or index, so no untimed-window precompute set exists), per-iteration schedules derived from that token (full phase: top-level block permutation plus dispersed class-preserving swaps plus one guaranteed token-boundary-altering delimiter substitution at an identifier head; incremental phase: 4-11 dispersed edits, EVERY one of them a guaranteed token-boundary-altering delimiter substitution at a schedule-selected identifier head, so no edit is lexically neutral or provably skippable), one warm repetition each, then nine timed repetitions with each phase scored from summed per-iteration minima: every timed iteration index keeps its fastest window across the nine repetitions and the phase estimate sums those minima, identically for candidate and reference (trusted trimmed sampling; timing noise is strictly additive, lands on iterations rather than phases, and is not candidate-controlled -- reference and candidate share the identical stored token per repetition/iteration slot, so the same content feeds both sides of every compared minimum; A-A probes on this host measured ~4% spread for both min-of-summed-phases and median-of-per-pair-ratios, while per-iteration minima give every iteration nine independent chances at a calm scheduling window and average the residuals across the 24-120 iterations of a phase). The trusted Python parent owns the clock: per timed iteration it waits for the leg's ready marker, starts the clock as it releases a single opaque parse-go token, and stops the clock on the leg's receipt; the token is first revealed to the leg at clock-start. The whole timed operation is derived from that token -- the per-iteration mutation is seeded by it, so mutation, parse, and the tree-signature digest all run after the token arrives and inside the measured window; the candidate-linked harness holds no clock to rewrite. The receipt folds the parse-go token together with the completed tree's content-inclusive signature -- the full pre-order (symbol, start_byte, end_byte) walk plus, for every leaf node, a rolling FNV of the parsed buffer's source bytes in that leaf's range -- so no correct receipt can be produced before the token exists or without completing the parse inside the timed window, and a schedule variant whose class-preserving swaps all land in token interiors (leaving the tree structurally byte-identical to the pristine parse) still changes every touched leaf's content fold and therefore the receipt. Every warmup and timed iteration parses identity-distinct schedule-variant content (class-preserving alphanumeric byte swaps dispersed across the whole buffer) so cached or replayed trees from any other iteration produce wrong receipts (structure-changing variants alter node boundaries; structure-neutral variants alter leaf content folds), and the parent folds each leg's receipt stream into a per-phase accumulator that must equal the pristine reference run on the identical token stream; byte counters re-verified against the sealed workload on every repetition; RSS gate uses the maximum candidate peak across all repetitions. Per-iteration plausibility floor: every candidate timed iteration must take at least the pristine reference leg's fastest same-phase iteration divided by 10, so a measured window collapsed toward a control-channel round-trip is rejected outright. Per-leg out-of-process CPU floor: each bench leg's total CPU time is read by the trusted parent from the kernel's reaped-child wait4 accounting (never candidate-reported), and a candidate leg whose CPU falls below 0.4x the same repetition's pristine reference leg is rejected as implausibly light on parse-proportional work
measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max
measurement.provisionalCalibrationNote: aa samples, sigma, qReference, and normalizationScale are measured under the reference-normalized per-iteration-fastest-of-nine CSPRNG-token evaluator on Docker Desktop and remain provisional local calibration; final GCE recalibration (deferred finding) re-freezes them on the target host
measurement.qReferenceConstruction: qBase + max(5*sigma, 0.05*abs(qBase-qFail)); the 5% floor dominates at the round-8 sigma
measurement.roundEightSchedule: every timed iteration applies guaranteed token-boundary-altering edits (schedule-selected identifier-head bytes overwritten with schedule-chosen delimiters from ';,()'); EVERY incremental-phase edit is one, so no schedule edit is lexically neutral and neither cached-structure replay nor under-registration of provably-neutral edits can reproduce the receipt (demonstrated 0/24 and 0/120 receipt matches for a ts_tree_copy skip stub on all six workloads); every timed full-phase iteration parses a schedule-driven item-granular permutation of the workload's 839-2399 top-level line-aligned blocks assembled into a scratch buffer (first 128 bytes never moved), so no privately cached tree of earlier content is reachable by a sparse edit script and cross-iteration full-parse memoization degenerates to full-parse-shaped re-lex work (best-case LIS alignment reuse ~2*sqrt(B)/B = 4-7%); RSS envelopes re-frozen with forty leg samples under the evaluator's exact leg-isolation preexec and tmpfs build root plus two full pilot runs of the trusted evaluator itself per split
